capabilities: Convert HWP, HWPX, HWPML, PDF, Excel, Word and PowerPoint files to Markdown
Preview HWPX files and edit paragraph, heading and table-cell text
Export the current Markdown note to HWPX with layout and font settings
Run document tools such as compare, form fields, stamps, redaction and table extraction
Expose document tools to AI agents through a local MCP server
extras: Desktop only. The OCR add-on is a separate ~200 MB Windows x64 ZIP from the GitHub release that must match the bundled engine version and be reinstalled after each plugin update. Network is off by default; an optional local MCP server listens on loopback, and an optional completion webhook posts the file name, result path and success flag.
problem: Korean HWP/HWPX documents and Office or PDF files cannot be read inside Obsidian, so their content has to be converted elsewhere or retyped.

relations.evidence: Verbex is currently the only agent host that implements agentinterop v1

summary: Converts Korean HWP, HWPX, HWPML, PDF and Office files to Markdown notes, previews and edits HWPX, and exports Markdown back to HWPX, all offline.
